out.explanation: Statement A on page 369 refers strictly to 'Total Secured Loans' (499.48 million, combining fund and non-fund-based), whereas Statement B on page 364 lists fund-based borrowings (88.85 million), non-fund-based borrowings (410.63 million), and unsecured loans (10.19 million) separately before arriving at the grand total of 509.67 million. These represent different components and sub-totals of the overall borrowings rather than inconsistent statements of the same figure.
